title: Bug 648781: check the party identifier that the PEPPOL export will use
summary: PEPPOL validation now uses the same party identifier provider as export to ensure EndpointID is never empty, fixing cases where validation passed but export created invalid documents.
key_points: Validation and export now use the same party identifier source instead of different logic
Purchase order validation now covers all document types instead of missing the Purchase Header branch
Users receive clear error messages indicating which settings need adjustment when EndpointID cannot be determined
Documents that previously exported invalid empty EndpointID values are now caught during validation
PEPPOL 3.0 Setup provider is consulted at validation time instead of hardcoding identifier logic
quote: Validation now asks the same party info provider that export uses and just checks the answer is not empty.
